nodes.title: Introduction / 简介 | Civitai@LostInHentaiThoughts
widgets_values:
This is a comfyUI Image2Image upscaling workflow that I developed for my eroDeity model series[https://civitai.com/models/252186], and it is designed to work with my Text2Image workflow. This workflow features: LoRA stack loading, high speed LCM generation, DynamicThreshoulding CFG control, face fix with FaceDetailer, and hand fix with HandRefiner.
这是我为 eroDeity 系列模型开发的 comfyUI 图生图放大与修复工作流，它是设计来与我的文生图工作流配合使用的。本工作流具有的内容：LoRA堆栈加载、DynamicThreshoulding 动态CFG控制、FaceDetailer 脸部修复及 HandRefiner 手部修复。
Only the final step of images are saved automatically, if you wish to save other middle step images, you can right click on preview box to download them.
注意：当前工作流只保存最后一步的图像（即脸部和手部修复后的结果）到本地，如需保存中间步骤，可在图像预览框中右键下载对应图片。

Workflow partially adapted from: 
Img2Img and extras upscaler like a1111[https://civitai.com/models/262820]
